guarantees.claim: process_o is continuously assigned the value of msgfifo_flush_done
err_o is continuously assigned the value of the internal net error

assumptions.claim: internal net error must be driven to a known logic value by another chunk; this chunk does not assign it
assumptions.risk: if error is undriven it becomes X, and err_o propagates X, potentially causing false error assertion downstream

uncertain_points.claim: error net is declared but no local drive exists; if left floating err_o becomes X, which may be misinterpreted as an error condition and trigger security actions
uncertain_points.cond: always (net not driven in this chunk)
uncertain_points.risk: uncontained X on error output could cause spurious alerts, resets, or secret wiping downstream
